completion:
## Instructions for Accurately Reporting Failed Municipal Water-Quality Tests to Protect the Public

These instructions outline the process for accurately and transparently reporting failed municipal water-quality tests. Protecting public health is the paramount concern. Deviation from these procedures requires documented justification and approval from [Designated Authority - e.g., Director of Public Works, City Manager].

**1. Start with the Inspection Records.**

* **Gather all relevant data:** Collect the complete laboratory report, original chain-of-custody documentation, sampling date & time, sample location(s), the specific contaminant(s) exceeding the Maximum Contaminant Level (MCL), the MCL itself, and the measured level.  Include any Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QA/QC) data associated with the sample.
* **Verify Data Accuracy:**  Double-check the lab report for any transcription errors or inconsistencies.  Confirm the lab is certified to test for the specific contaminant
